{{Quote|I am Ranjiyn. Like my colleagues, a representative of the Unity, of Ansion's city and town dwellers. We of the towns and cities welcome you, the representatives of the Jedi Council, to Ansion and extend to you all the hospitality and cooperation of which we are capable.|Ranjiyn|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Ranjiyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ansionian]] who was one of the seven delegates of the [[Unity Council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He appeared to be the first among equals of the group, and dyed his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in alternating black-and-white stripes.<ref name="AS" />
